notes.title: ⚒️ Update 1.2.0 is Live!
notes.content:
Hello there, our amazing [b]Istanbul[/b] community! 👋 You can now [b]update the game to version 1.2.0[/b] and enjoy the fresh features and changes! 😀

[h2]🎮 Gamepad control settings and Steam Deck support![/h2]
You asked, we delivered! Istanbul: Digital Edition now features full [b]gamepad support[/b], meaning you can comfortably play the game from your couch, your desk, or even on the go. Even better, the game is now fully [b]playable on Steam Deck[/b], with a tailored control scheme and interface adjustments. We’ve done some tuning under the hood to make sure controls feel snappy and intuitive no matter how you play. ⚡

[h2]☁️ Steam Cloud[/h2]
With [b]Steam Cloud[/b] integration now live, your game saves sync automatically across all your devices. No need to worry about switching between your main PC and Steam Deck or losing progress. Just pick up right where you left off, and continue your journey to collect those Rubies! 🥳

[h2]🎨 Community Items just for you![/h2]
Show your love for the Grand Bazaar even outside the game. We’ve added Istanbul [b]Community Items[/b], which means you can now [b]collect and trade cards[/b], unlock exclusive [b]Profile Backgrounds[/b], and express yourself with new [b]Emoticons[/b]. Dive into the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/943410][b]Points Shop[/b][/url] and make your Steam profile as rich and vibrant as your merchant empire! 🤩

https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/943410

[h2]🎵 Music Bug Fix[/h2]
Some of you noticed that the background music didn’t quite sound right, with odd distortions and unexpected audio artifacts during gameplay. We’ve tracked down the cause and fixed it, so the music now plays correctly and as intended. Thanks to everyone who flagged this quirky issue. 🎧

[h2] 📋 Full Changelog v1.2.0[/h2]
Here’s everything that’s included in this update:

[Feature] Gamepad control settings are now supported.
[Feature] The game is now playable on Steam Deck.
[Feature] Steam Cloud support is now enabled.
[QoL] Added animations to Locations and backgrounds.
[QoL] Screen resolution and windowed mode can now be adjusted from the Settings menu.
[QoL] Moved the tutorial from the bottom of the rules section into its own dedicated tab.
[QoL] Added feedback category selection to the feedback form.
[Engine] Updated the game engine and improved overall performance of the app.
[Fix] Fixed issues causing music crashes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33708638/983829b866afa36890d0ff77c515ef87969e4652.png[/img]

[h2]☕ Add Mocha & Baksheesh to Your Wishlist - Final Stretch![/h2]
We’re wrapping up Beta Testing for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3100160/Istanbul_Digital_Edition__Mocha__Baksheesh/?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=update120][b]Mocha & Baksheesh DLC[/b][/url] soon, and getting ready for its official release! This expansion adds Coffee as a new resource, introduces new Locations and strategic options, and brings even more depth to your Istanbul sessions.

🔥 Make sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3100160/Istanbul_Digital_Edition__Mocha__Baksheesh/?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=update120][b]add it to your Wishlist[/b][/url] so you don’t miss the launch! 🔥

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3100160/Istanbul_Digital_Edition__Mocha__Baksheesh/?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=update120
And while you're here, if you enjoy clever card combos and tough-but-rewarding decision-making, you might want to check out something else we've been working on. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924580/Inkborn/?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=istanbul&utm_campaign=update120][b]Inkborn[/b][/url] is our upcoming roguelike deckbuilder, and there’s a free [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3481080/Inkborn_Combat_Demo/?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=istanbul&utm_campaign=update120][b]Combat Demo[/b][/url] available on Steam!

👉 Try the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3481080/Inkborn_Combat_Demo/?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=istanbul&utm_campaign=update120][b]Inkborn Combat Demo[/b][/url] and let us know what you think, we’d love to hear your feedback!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3481080/Inkborn_Combat_Demo/?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=istanbul&utm_campaign=update120
Thanks for playing and for supporting Istanbul: Digital Edition! 🕌 For the next days (until [b]July 10th[/b], 2025) you can grab our games at a special discount as part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Acram][b]Summer Sale[/b][/url]! Don’t miss out, and see you in the Bazaar! 💎

notes.title: Istanbul: Digital Edition is a part of Turn-Based Carnival 2024! 🎲
notes.content:
[b]Istanbul: Digital Edition[/b] is joining another exciting edition of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Acram/sale/Turn-BasedCarnival2024][b]Turn-Based Carnival[/b][/url]!

This event is a tribute to the games that make us think, plan, and savor every move. It's a chance to celebrate the creativity, depth, and diversity of turn-based gameplay. 👇

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Acram/sale/Turn-BasedCarnival2024][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953556/96dad9192d8cbcd0dc58b95033113ed9362507dd.png[/img][/url]

But that’s not all!

We have some exciting news to share! Alongside the [b]Turn-Based Carnival[/b], we are proud to announce our first original game - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924580/Inkborn/&utm_source=Steam&utm_medium=TBCxInkborne&utm_campaign=Announcement][b]Inkborn[/b][/url], a roguelike deckbuilder that takes players on a dynamic, strategic journey unlike anything you've experienced before. Set to release on [b]Early Access in Q2 2025[/b]! 🖋️

What sets [b]Inkborn[/b] apart? 🃏
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924580/Inkborn/&utm_source=Steam&utm_medium=TBCxInkborne&utm_campaign=Announcement][b]Inkborn[/b][/url] features an innovative combo system where players discover powerful moves by playing cards in specific sequences, reminiscent of classic fighting game combos but with a unique twist. Our original [b]Origami art style[/b] and evolving roster of character classes make every run feel unique. At launch, players can experiment with [b]over 100 kinds of cards[/b], and we'll be expanding the game with more characters, cards, and features leading up to the [b]Full Release in Q2 2026[/b]. 🎮

Stay tuned for more updates, and prepare to embark on an unforgettable journey of intricate folds and strategic choices. Add [b]Inkborn[/b] to your wishlist and follow to stay in the loop! 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924580/Inkborn/?utm_source=Steam&utm_medium=TBCxInkborne&utm_campaign=Announcement

notes.title: Discover New Locations and Features in the Mocha & Baksheesh DLC!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to share an exciting update on the highly anticipated [b]‘Mocha & Baksheesh’ expansion[/b]. Over the past few weeks, we've been posting exclusive development updates on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/mNXayWYC4U][b]Discord server[/b][/url], showcasing the progress and new features. For those who might have missed these updates, here’s a summary of the most interesting features we've implemented so far. 😁

[h2]New Locations & Enhanced Gameplay Features [i]([url=https://discord.com/invite/mNXayWYC4U]check the full animations on the Discord[/url])[/i][/h2]
[b]Coffee House[/b] - a place where you can trade Coffee beans for highly coveted Rubies! ☕
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33708638/23a9c978915eb12b95781e71afc321346b35215f.png[/img]
[b]Guild Hall[/b] is a significant location where you can obtain Guild Cards. A total of 20 Guild Cards will be available in the game, each with various applications. 🃏
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33708638/bad2f7063b952b6dfe9a34d5d9bfa4a2272270c3.png[/img]
The current look of the encounter with the [b]Coffee Trader[/b]:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33708638/fb695e620b513f644fe1cd6baa88909b165f51d0.png[/img]
[h2]Community Feedback[/h2]
We’ve been actively listening to your feedback and are excited to share that many of your suggestions have been incorporated into this expansion.

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]
Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to refine and expand our DLC. Join our Discord server to participate in exclusive beta tests and give us your thoughts on upcoming features: [url=https://discord.com/invite/mNXayWYC4U]https://discord.com/invite/mNXayWYC4U[/url]

We’re incredibly grateful for your support and can’t wait for you to experience all the new content we’ve been working on. 💪

notes.title: Concordia: Digital Edition Salsa DLC is out!
notes.content:
[h1]The long awaited first major DLC for Concordia: Digital Edition is now available for purchase! [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/ace1ce32219990cb0b05c28ed1f4c5063a536072.jpg[/img]
 
As of now you can access [b]Salt [/b]and [b]Forum [/b]modules, and [b]Hispania [/b]and [b]Byzantium[/b] maps on [b]iOS[/b], [b]Android[/b], [b]Steam[/b], and [b]GOG[/b]!

[b]Salt[/b] is a new kind of trading good that can not be bought or sold - it can only be acquired from Salt producing cities. It's also the most valuable of all the trading goods, as it can serve as any other good for the purposes of house construction or points scoring!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/0d91ee370eba5be96bfa58b32c3b4ecd4c70ebc9.png[/img]

[b]Forum [/b]is a mechanic bringing a whole new set of Forum Cards, where you get patricians and regular citizens to help you throughout the game. The bonuses they provide are either a one-time use powerful ability or an ongoing change to core game mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/30956dab5c2f60887dfd374f4412f7011e06a78e.png[/img]

[b]Hispania & Byzantium[/b] are the two maps that come with the [b]Salsa DLC[/b]. They don't bring any new mechanics by themselves, but the different layout in itself will significantly impact the gameplay and the tactics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/6bda6cb100f1ac2cea9273c71529f313963bcdd4.png[/img]

[h1]Last call for the tournament![/h1]

Don't forget you can still sign up for the [b]Concordia: Digital Edition Online Tournament![/b]
 
All you need is the base game of Concordia and the will to compete! The event is completely [b]free of charge[/b] and there are [b]real prizes to be won[/b] provided by us (Acram Digital) and PD-Verlag - the publisher of the tabletop Concordia! 

More information [b]here[/b].

notes.title: Concordia: Digital Edition - Salsa DLC releasing on the 01/27/22
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/a8a9b793b844bb91609911503d56995239b1554f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Big news for all you Concordia fans! [/h1]

[h2]The first of the three big DLC pieces is releasing next week - on the 27th of January 2022![/h2]

[b]Salsa [/b]introduces two modules - [b]Salt trading good[/b], and [b]Forum mechanic[/b], and two more additional [b]maps - Hispania and Byzantium[/b]!

[b]Salt [/b]is a new kind of trading good that can not be bought or sold - it can only be acquired from Salt producing cities. It's also the most valuable of all the trading goods, as it can serve as any other good for the purposes of house construction or points scoring!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/0d91ee370eba5be96bfa58b32c3b4ecd4c70ebc9.png[/img]

[b]Forum [/b]is a mechanic bringing a whole new set of Forum Cards, where you get patricians and regular citizens to help you throughout the game. The bonuses they provide are either a one-time use powerful ability or an ongoing change to core game mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/30956dab5c2f60887dfd374f4412f7011e06a78e.png[/img]

[b]Hispania & Byzantium[/b] are the two maps that come with the Salsa DLC. They don't bring any new mechanics by themselves, but the different layout in itself will significantly impact the gameplay and the tactics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/6bda6cb100f1ac2cea9273c71529f313963bcdd4.png[/img]

[b]Salsa DLC[/b] has been in beta testing for a while now - both by the dedicated beta testers as well as the Season Pass owners who chose to try and err the beta content. 

And if you're excited about trying content early - you still can! [b]The Season Pass[/b] owners, regardless of platform, can always opt in and out of the beta content and try the DLCs mechanics and maps a bit ahead of time!

[h1]Add Salsa to your wishlist today![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1707530/Concordia_Digital_Edition__Salsa/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1708670/Concordia_Digital_Edition__Season_Pass/
